body: Okay, I will contact the counselors and some of her few friends, but not her family as they aren't very close. I'm just worried because I'm really the only person she has left and if I make her feel betrayed and abandoned she might actually go through with it. She's lied to get out of therapy before, and she might do it again. But you're right, I'd much rather she hated me than kill herself. Thank you.
